projectSummary: Supports the general statement that mechanism and tear location are related, in a young active population. The individual mechanisms were not extracted into a count in this pass.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Military cohort, retrospective imaging review, no denominator of exposure.

study.intervention: Retrospective MRI series in an active-duty military cohort.
study.population: MRI of pectoralis major injuries in an active-duty military cohort found that the mechanism of injury was related to the location of the tear.

title: Magnetic Resonance Imaging of Pectoralis Major Injuries in an Active Duty Military Cohort: Mechanism Affects Tear Location.
